__Why?__
• Your Discord client is out of date.

__What do I do?__
• Be sure your client is updated and clear cache. 
• Reinstall if the problem persists.

<a:TDex:852261416479752223> **The application did not respond**
*Limitations of bot usage.* 

__Why?__
• Incorrect command usage in the channel.
• Rate limitation. 
• Shards are restarting.

Hello, <#854826817416462376> is a channel dedicated to starting incense in <@716390085896962058>. Here are some helpful things to know:

- Using an incense spawns **180** Pokémon at a rate of one every __20 seconds__ for a total of __1 hour__ of consecutive catching.
- One incense costs **50 shards**, or **10,000 PC**. 
- You can buy shards by using <@716390085896962058> buy shards {amount}. 
- You can buy an incense by using <@716390085896962058> buy incense. 

It is worth noting that when incense is bought, it starts immediately. It is not stored and you don't get to choose when to use it, once bought it will start in the channel you bought it immediately.

Hello there! Depending on the raid pass, there are different ways to obtain them:

**Orange Daily Pass**
- This pass is granted once per day when spinning a gym stop. You can only have one at a time in your inventory.

**Green Premium Raid Pass**
- These can be bought in boxes or stacks with Pokécoins in the shop in Pokémon Go or earned in certain special/limited research tasks.

**Pink/Purple Remote Raid Pass**
- Bought with Pokécoins in boxes or stacks from the shop in Pokémon Go. They also have a small chance to be given from the *Weekly Research Breakthrough Box* as a reward.
